steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: We're down thirteen civilians and nine soldiers.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Rhodes Island...

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: They're proving to be quite troublesome.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: General, we've finished the head count on the remaining Dublinn soldiers.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Give them one chance.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Those willing to join us will enter the mercenary squad.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: As for those who aren't... You already know what to do with them.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Yessir!
Not your best showing, General Manfred.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: ...I didn't expect for Confessarius's Messenger to still be here.

steps.name: Confessarius Guard
steps.text: Both the Leader and the Regent are concerned about the battle situation unfolding in this inconspicuous corner.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: I trust the Sanguinarch is no exception.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: After all, his generosity last night took a lot of the pressure off of us.

steps.name: Confessarius Guard
steps.text: Oh right, he wanted me to let you know, the atmosphere here is too filthy. He doesn't plan to wait around much longer.

steps.name: Confessarius Guard
steps.text: At the moment, he is in the unfortunate process of requisitioning the property of a factory owner, and will be enjoying a late dinner.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Requisitioning?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: I do hope that... whoever the Prince 'requisitioned' the factory from isn't one of our partners.

steps.name: Confessarius Guard
steps.text: Does that matter?

steps.name: Confessarius Guard
steps.text: These inefficient factories provide us with hardly anything worthwhile. All they do is breed pests.

steps.name: Confessarius Guard
steps.text: His patience will only last until tomorrow night.

steps.name: Confessarius Guard
steps.text: If you are unable to provide him with a satisfactory banquet, then he will 'sweep' these filthy streets as he sees appropriate.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Is this the Sanguinarch's intent, or the decision of the Military Commission?

steps.name: Confessarius Guard
steps.text: Always fussing over these irrelevant details. This is exactly why you've been pinned down in this little dump. His Highness expected more of you.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: ...Please report back to the Prince: We are deeply grateful for his assistance, and will proceed with the next phase of the operation.

steps.name: Confessarius Guard
steps.text: Very well. We look forward to seeing your results.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Heading off to war isn't nearly as much of a slog as talking to these Royal Court people, eh?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: So this is where you've been hiding.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: I assure you, I haven't been slacking off.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: You can stop cradling that arm you nearly lost. Tell me, which of your old acquaintances did that to you? The one with the explosives, or the one with the sword?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Sorry, it hurts so bad I can't remember anything.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Since they left you with another arm to pick up a sword with, it seems whoever it was still has a soft spot for you.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: It's almost daybreak.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: ...Yeah, looks like it.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Stop leaning against the wall in a daze. Break time's over.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Mercenaries aren't eligible for sick leave, right?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Let's go. This battle is far from over.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: How many injured are there? Take them to get treated right now!

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: I'll also help out!

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Mhm, thank you.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Bring Harmo over here. We have to speed up the evacuation.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Also, dispatch some Messengers outside the city. Worst case scenario, we need to be prepared to relocate the bulk of the population.

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: Yes, Commander!

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Miss Siege...

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Miss Siege?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Oh... Sorry, your voice always makes my mind wander off.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: You must be exhausted. Just like our soldiers.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Thanks for your concern. I'm hanging in there.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: The piece of intel you brought back— that the warriors of Team 6 were slaughtered by extremely terrifying Originium Arts, is critically important to us.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: If only I could've gone to the surface to check on them sooner...

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: No, you would've been in danger too.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Besides, you've already done enough. If not for your quick-thinking, it might not have been just Team 6 that ran into him, but the rest of our troops and your people as well.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Who is he? Those Sarkaz soldiers seemed to call him a prince.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: ...Three months ago, a nobles' banquet was held in northern Londinium.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: It began with great fanfare. The lights stayed on the entire night, and it wasn't until the servants went to clean the venue on the second day that they discovered that the only thing left was a still-playing record player.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Everyone was dead?

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: All killed in a single instant, it seems. Some of them still kept their posture from the moment of death, glasses raised in a toast.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Among the slain were those with connections with us. Heidi knew them too.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: That's right.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: I lost several old friends that night. The Self-Salvation Corps also lost a significant portion of its network throughout the city.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: It's not for no reason that we retreated to the edge of the wall.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: But it's thanks to Heidi's unfaltering efforts that we've managed to survive. And soon enough, we'll have a chance to face the Sarkaz head-on.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Before that though... we still need to escape the gaze of that terrifying individual.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Amiya, would you happen to know who he is?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: If my hunch is correct, the person looming above us is probably... a vampire.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: ...This'll be tough.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: How tough?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: To be honest, it's probably easier for me to make a new one from scratch than try to glue the pieces together.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Don't have the parts.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Huh? No way...

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: We're in Londinium. Most of the city's industrial resources are controlled by the Sarkaz, and we don't exactly have the luxury of scrounging up scraps for something that won't be used on the battlefield.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Your work environment is way too...

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Impoverished? You can speak your mind, the commander isn't here.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: ...Way too much of a challenge. *cough* *cough*...

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Miss Closure...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: What's up?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: D-Did you know, when you talk about being challenged, your eyes seem to... light up? Physically.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Huh? Really? Must be because I'm getting excited... Is it scary?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I-It's fine.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: To be honest, it wasn't until I met you that I found out... Uhh, that Sarkaz can do more than just fight.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Oh... Uh, there are a lot of people who aren't fighters, like me.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Naturally, I'm a vampire, so of course I was born with some handy talents.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Huh? Y-You... what is this speed?! It'd take a week for me to do what you did in a single night!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Why do you think the pillars of Rhodes Island are so good?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Take a good look at my eyes. If the Rhodes Island landship was filled with vampires, working at night would be no problem, and we'd cut down big on the electricity bill.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Are there... a lot of vampire engineers?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Of course not! They... They all...

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Hey, why'd you start shuddering all of a sudden?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Blame Londinium. It's been a long time since I last felt the fear of being this close to a den of evil. Look, my hands are totally frozen stiff! And I need these hands!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Could it be... that Team 6 ran into...?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I sure hope not.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: If so... For real, I need to give you guys a serious warning.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Just in case... I mean, just in case—if you ever run into another vampire, run!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: No, it might already be too late by then.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I hope you'll never...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Never ever bump into them.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Morgan, you and Indra will go help the Self-Salvation Corps relocate.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Mm, I'll be there right away.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: What is it, Doctor?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Were you looking for me?

options: I want to talk about Dagda.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Dagda... made her decision.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I... When I had to take up the mantle as their leader, I've never stopped thinking about how to do the right thing.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: And at Rhodes Island, I saw how you went about doing that.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I'm fine... But, I'm really worried about Dagda.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: It's no different from how you're worried about us, though. We both have our own responsibilities to shoulder.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Dagda is... pretty much in the same situation as me.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Every moment she stayed with me, her actions were bound by responsibility. No matter how many times I told her to make her own decisions, she would never be able to choose any other outcome.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: When we truly have the capacity to make a choice, what truly matters is having the authority to make that so-called choice. Otherwise, it is nothing more than coercion, wrapped in a more palatable package.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I don't want to have to push her along ever again. She needs to accept herself, and then walk down her own path with conviction.

options: You can continue like this and become a regular soldier.
You can also go to them and tell them who you really are.
No matter what you decide, Rhodes Island and I will support you.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Becoming a run-of-the-mill soldier might be the easy way out.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: But my family name... No matter what you all decide to call me, I can't deny my name. It's a part of me.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I hope I didn't scare you by telling you the truth, Doctor.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit said she was willing to tell you, but I decided to do it myself.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: You don't seem all that surprised.

options: Maybe because I don't remember the past.
Maybe because I only care about the present.
Maybe because I'm looking ahead to the future.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: ...You don't remember the past?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Even though you've suffered so much due to that... I can't help but wonder, is your life a little bit easier because you can't remember?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: That's right, what's most important is always the present.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: When I made the decision to leave Victoria, all I wanted was for me and Indra to live to see this moment.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: The future...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Which way... will my future take me?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Only I can answer that question. Nobody else can.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Phew... When I'm around you, I can always relax so easily.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: It might be because... even when you found out the truth, the only person reflected in your eyes was the operator known as 'Siege'.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Instead of... Victoria.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Coming back to Londinium has brought back many memories.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: But at the same time, so much has changed.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: The decisions I make no longer solely affect my team.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Doctor... I don't actually want 'choice' to be an excuse that holds me back.

options: I'm here today as a result of my choices.
My choices determine how I move forward.
Someone once said I'd find my own path.
Vina, I want to share those words with you too.
You always have the right to choose.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Miss Heidi.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Amiya? I'm currently tending to the wounded.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You... practice medicine?

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Only some basic nursing techniques.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: This job inevitably brings me into emergency situations. To give me and my friends a better shot at survival, I had to at least learn to use a first-aid kit.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You're really amazing.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: All we're doing is protecting our home. But Kal'tsit... and you, Amiya, you all carry so much more responsibility on your shoulders.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...We've lost a lot of people on this operation.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I... I feel the pain of the Self-Salvation Corps' soldiers. They've never had to deal with such horrific enemies before.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The Sanguinarch... Did he come here because of us?

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Amiya, what you need to hear isn't me saying 'no, it's not your fault.'

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Yes...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Clovisia said she was afraid Rhodes Island would get the Self-Salvation Corps involved in a war they weren't a part of.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: If working with us puts them at greater risk...

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: During last night's operation, what would've happened if Rhodes Island had not been there?

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Without W colluding, had she not stopped the mercenary leader... and without Rhodes Island's operators keeping Manfred at bay, we wouldn't even be having this conversation right now.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: The calculus of exchanging one set of lives for another simply does not exist for Rhodes Island—

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: But even if Kal'tsit were here, I'm sure she would say every opportunity comes with its risks.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I understand.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: That's why we have to be better prepared.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Miss Heidi, I need more information from within the city. Not counting the Sanguinarch, how many kings do the Sarkaz have inside Londinium?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Excuse me, I'd like a bag of bread.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: I don't need your money, lass. Take all of these with you.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: Hurry along, and don't come out here again.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: What do you mean...?

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: I know who you are. Actually, we can all tell.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: Even if you took off your equipment and changed your clothes, both your actions and the look in your eyes won't fool anyone.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: ...Thank you.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: I might as well pack up too. Don't think there's business to be had today.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: We're doing another sweep of this street! Take away anyone whose name is on the list!

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: Wh-What's going on? I... I'm just a restauranteur. Didn't you come by to have fried finmeat before...?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: You're the one we're after.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Your cover runs pretty deep. Selling fried meat to us by day, peddling information to the rebels by night?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Take them away! And check those buildings next door. They're all rebels!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Why are the Sarkaz suddenly going around grabbing people?

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: H-Hurry, take a turn at the alley just ahead and find the others—

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: Ugh—!

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Another one down.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: You lot, search that alley over there. Don't let a single one of them escape this borough.

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: Report, we ran into Sarkaz as soon as we came out...

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: No, they weren't guarding the city exits, they suddenly appeared in the middle of the streets!

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: Commander, do you think our comms have been compromised?

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: Please be careful... The soldiers dispatched out of the city have all perished. I can't hide for much longer either!

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: I—

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: Bloody hell, why can't I shake them off?

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: The Sarkaz seem to have suddenly figured out all our passages and networks!

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: In just... a single night...?

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: What exactly happened last night?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Haha, wouldn't you like to know.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Huh? What the hell are you? My blade snapped clean in half—

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: The way you're dressed... Are you a Rhodes Island operator? Thank you. You guys saved us again.

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: Hurry back.

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: Wait, be sure to tell Amiya and the Doctor that the underground isn't safe anymore.

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: The traps we ran into yesterday... aren't the only ones we've discovered.
